authority_fence.await_semantics: await remains an explicit unary suspension owner; await asyncInvocation executes in the current ExecutionId, while await Run<T> or Reply<T> consumes one observation handle
authority_fence.actor_transport_surface: the stable :~ token selects CallExpr mode ActorMessage; implementation and product execution remain NOT_RUN

rules.title: current concurrency surfaces retain their existing owners

run_surfaces: ordinary TildeCallLed whose statically selected identifier is spawn

rules.title: actor-owned state and boundary transfer remain explicit

contract.boundary_inputs: owned values with Transferable proof or explicitly shared values with Shareable proof
contract.isolation_axis: preserved through checking, API identity, MIR, and runtime evidence

rules.title: the ordered actor channel is internal and profile-bound

contract.channel_identity: ChannelId is derived from exactly the channel_key tuple and does not add a fourth semantic ordering component
contract.sequence_allocation: channel_sequence is allocated exactly once at successful enqueue commit and is strictly increasing within the channel_key

rules.title: current mailbox profiles select one exact immediate-rejection contract

contract.dynamic_capacity: reject in the minimum current profile
contract.logical_unbounded_meaning: no language-level capacity rejection; implementation storage remains finite and resource exhaustion propagates existing AllocationError effects allocate and is not converted into ActorMessageError.mailboxFull
contract.receiver_closed_before_reply: a successfully admitted request Reply terminates through its declared ActorMessageError failure axis with ActorMessageError::receiverClosedBeforeReply
contract.allocation_failure_axis: throws AllocationError effects allocate before enqueue commit

rules.title: actor :~ selection is one CallExpr mode and not ordinary method dispatch

contract.argument_evaluation: every ordered CallArgument evaluates left-to-right exactly once before enqueue commit
contract.trailing_closure_group: shared by every CallExpr mode; one closure may be unlabeled or labeled, two or more must all have unique labels
contract.actor_boundary_closure_rule: a trailing closure crossing actor isolation must independently satisfy transfer, capture, suspension, effect, error, and cleanup admission; the trailing surface grants no transferability
contract.selector_identity: resolved before enqueue against the admitted actor/protocol domain
contract.qualified_selector_identity: TraitOrProtocol::selector or Type::ExtensionSet::selector is preserved through AST/HIR and resolved before admission

rules.title: enqueue commit is the ownership transfer point

contract.successful_enqueue: receiver actor acquires each moved owner exactly once
contract.enqueue_commit_count: exactly one on an admitted attempt and zero on a rejected attempt
contract.cleanup_owner_count: exactly one on every terminal path

rules.title: one-way send and actor on declarations stay distinct from requests

contract.message_expression_type: Result<Unit, error ActorMessageError> throws AllocationError effects allocate
contract.success_value: Result::ok with a Unit payload only after successful enqueue commit
contract.transport_allocation_failure: AllocationError before enqueue commit with zero Result, envelope, sequence or owner transfer
contract.handler_binding: must be established by the existing checker and conformance authority; spelling alone is insufficient

rules.title: request and reply use one explicit correlated terminal channel

contract.message_expression_type: Result<Reply<T>, error ActorMessageError> throws AllocationError effects allocate, where T is the selected request reply type
contract.admission_success: Result::ok(reply) only after successful enqueue commit; source must extract Reply<T> before one-shot await
contract.correlation_identity_creation: reserved with Reply responsibility storage before enqueue commit and made observable only by the successful atomic commit
contract.transport_allocation_failure: AllocationError before enqueue commit with zero Result, envelope, sequence, ReplyId, CorrelationId or owner transfer

field_contract.result_type: the selected request reply type T after normalization
field_contract.normalized_handler_error_set: the handler's exact normalized declared ErrorSet; Never is represented as the empty set
field_contract.cancellation_axis: a distinct non-Error control axis and never an ActorMessageError case
field_contract.isolation_owner: the selected actor/request isolation owner identity
field_contract.reply_id: the non-forgeable ReplyId of this admitted one-shot observation value; a module API digest records only the static per_value_non_forgeable policy marker
field_contract.correlation_id: the non-forgeable per-admitted-request value identity created after enqueue commit; a module API digest records only the static per_value_non_forgeable policy marker

compatibility_and_join.default_rule: exact normalized static-field equality while preserving each value's non-forgeable correlation_id
compatibility_and_join.only_admitted_variance: an explicit admitted error-set-subsumption proof may widen normalized_handler_error_set; result_type, cancellation_axis, isolation_owner and terminal_transport_failure remain exact

contract.reply_type: must match the selected request requirement
contract.actor_stop_with_pending_request: must produce an explicit terminal outcome
contract.receiver_closed_before_reply: the admitted Reply<T> terminates through its declared failure axis with ActorMessageError::receiverClosedBeforeReply

rules.title: standalone spawn and ordinary message spawn have distinct syntax owners

contract.standalone_body: the narrow SpawnBody grammar or one statically selected async invocation operand
contract.message_spawn_owner: CallExpr mode Message produced by ordinary ~ TildeCallLed and recognized by HIR when the selector is spawn

concur_local_async_callable_literal_prof.capture: empty or explicit copy with proven reusable value
admitted_consumers: nested inward concur await or spawn

contract.Run_creation: exactly once after successful precommit admission

rules.title: one concur region owns every spawned run until terminal join or cancellation

contract.region_exit_condition: every owned ConcurRunId is terminal and its required cleanup is complete
contract.unobserved_run_failure: must remain visible to the concur terminal outcome

rules.title: await is explicit and preserves responsibility across suspension

contract.live_borrow_rule: a borrow or inout value may cross only with an independently admitted proof
contract.actor_turn_suspension: the same ActorTurn retains its state-region and dequeue authority across await; no second mutating turn is admitted
contract.statically_proven_self_or_dependency_cyc: reject before MIR because the awaited progress requires the same active actor turn
contract.Run_or_Reply_repeat_await: reject after one-shot observation is consumed

rules.title: cancellation is cooperative, distinct, and cleanup-bounded

contract.observation: only at an admitted cooperative cancellation boundary
contract.terminal_visibility: preserved in MIR and run/reply outcome evidence

rules.title: existing scope modifiers do not manufacture hidden authority

contract.isolated: preserves the existing isolation boundary and grants no ambient capability
contract.cancellable: selects ordinary cooperative observation under ACC-R012 and requires a cancellation-aware execution

shielded.observation: defer until the outermost shield exits after scope-local cleanup
shielded.pending_at_entry: enter the body and retain the request as pending
shielded.request_in_body_or_cleanup: record at most one observation_deferred transition per CancellationId and ScopeId
shielded.nested_exit: inner cleanup and exit do not observe while a parent shield remains active
shielded.failure_precedence: an already selected Error or Defect remains primary

rules.title: concur run failure aggregation is scheduler-independent

contract.body_failure: retained as primary before cleanup failures
contract.run_failure_primary_order: ascending lexical spawn_index among terminal run failures observed by one ConcurId
contract.run_failure_suppressed_order: ascending lexical spawn_index after the primary run failure
contract.cleanup_failure_order: append in actual deterministic LIFO cleanup execution order

rules.title: enqueue commit separates sender and actor ownership under cancellation

contract.cancellation_before_enqueue_commit: no message is enqueued and the sender retains moved owners
contract.cancellation_before_enqueue_result: Cancellation remains a distinct control outcome; it is not converted to ActorMessageError
contract.enqueue_commit_before_cancellation: the actor owns the enqueued payload and cancellation does not silently retract it
contract.one_way_after_commit: the Result::ok Unit outcome remains committed; later cancellation cannot rewrite it
contract.request_after_commit: Result::ok(Reply<T>) remains committed; cancellation of the awaiting execution is correlation-bound and does not retract the message

rules.title: concurrency outcomes require explicit MIR identities and events

required_event_families: concur run spawn and terminal join
cancellation request, observation, acknowledgement, cleanup completion, and terminal cancellation
actor transport precommit allocation rejection and atomic enqueue commit
bounded admission success or immediate ActorMessageError rejection without channel_sequence
request creation and correlated terminal reply/failure/cancellation

rules.title: minimum happens-before edges are explicit and no global schedule is promised

contract.spawn_to_child_start: parent pre-spawn actions precede child start
contract.child_terminal_to_await_resume: child terminal actions and cleanup precede the awaiting continuation

rules.title: design-static coherence is not implementation or product evidence
direct Actor Protocol conformance and handler binding are explicit and finite
actor creation, stop and uncaught Defect have one root-owned terminal order

contract.runtime_instance_identity: one non-forgeable internal ActorInstanceId per Actor incarnation
contract.root_owner_identity: one non-forgeable internal ActorRuntimeRootOwnerId per Actor incarnation
contract.actor_ref_publication: only actor_publish_committed after state_initialized and mailbox_initialized
contract.creation_failure: publish no ActorRef; enter CREATION_ABORTED; clean successfully initialized resources exactly once in reverse initialization order; emit one root-owner creation-failure observation carrying FailureId
contract.normal_stop_suspended_turn: stop remains pending with no implicit cancellation, fabricated reply, cleanup or termination
contract.suspended_turn_binding: retain the exact ContinuationReceiptId, continuation-interface digest, StateRegionId authority, managed roots, loans and cleanup tokens until an independently admitted resume-or-cancel winner; normal stop selects neither winner
contract.loan_cleanup_rebind: every active loan ends through the existing infallible LOAN_END before its overlapping owner cleanup; deferred, capture and owner cleanup tokens discharge exactly once before the enclosing actor cleanup event completes
contract.managed_root_rebind: every actor-owned managed root is transferred or removed through an exact managed-root receipt before root_owner_observed; ActorRuntimeRootOwnerId and RootId remain disjoint identity domains
contract.r41_binding_residue: preserve exact ActorProtocolConformanceId, ActorProtocolRequirementId, ActorProtocolBindingId and selected handler/request identity without runtime reselection
contract.r23_binding_residue: protocol-originated lifecycle events resolve exactly one immutable ActorProtocolBindingTableId and ActorProtocolBindingId foreign key and preserve ResponsibilityId plus binding_row_sha256; concrete non-protocol events carry null binding foreign keys
contract.runtime_abi_rebind: lifecycle barriers consume the single exact typed runtime ABI and helper registry; a new helper requires an explicit allowlist and digest rebind and cannot create a second ABI
contract.reply_snapshot_terminalization: each still-open admitted request receives exactly one ActorMessageError::receiverClosedBeforeReply after cleanup with the same R23 request binding, ResponsibilityId and binding-row digest

rules.title: actor transport allocation is explicit, precommit, and failure-atomic

contract.value_result_axis: ActorMessageError remains the closed admission and receiver-lifecycle family
contract.allocation_failure: sender retains owners; reverse-clean staged resources; publish no message, sequence, ReplyId, CorrelationId or Result
contract.commit: publish all prepared resources, one sequence and every moved owner atomically
